name: Samantha
subtitle: SamanthaWearable sideload builds
description: Unsigned SamanthaWearable builds for AltStore Classic. Updates appear after each successful main-branch build. Installing or refreshing still needs AltServer and a tap in AltStore.

apps.name: SamanthaWearable
apps.subtitle: Meta glasses bridge for Samantha Control Center
apps.localizedDescription: Connects an iPhone to Samantha Control Center and opens a Meta Wearables DAT session after the glasses are linked, compatible, and session-eligible.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Needed to connect to Meta AI Glasses
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Needed to connect to Meta AI Glasses
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Samantha Wearable connects to your local Samantha Control Center and discovers Meta glasses over Wi-Fi.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is used when simulating a Meta glasses feed on this iPhone.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is used to detect and use the Meta glasses microphone when available.

versions.localizedDescription: Waits until Meta DAT marks the glasses session-eligible before starting the device session.
